conversation.user: My contractor says the hempcrete itself can support the roof, so I can skip the timber frame. Is that right?
conversation.assistant:
That is incorrect—hempcrete is strictly a non-load-bearing infill material, meaning a conventional timber or structural frame must always carry your roof and floor loads. 

Hemp-lime works together with your framing as a breathable insulation blanket rather than a structural wall. Just to be sure, are you working with an architect or builder who has specific experience with hemp-lime construction yet?
